native.captureScope: One 20-second accepted / one 20-second healthy candidate, same 1280x820 point window and 10k generated collection, settled indexing, 4-page forward/reverse warmup then 6 forward/6 reverse one-page scrolls plus Select All/Deselect. Scripted accessibility input, not a physical gesture.

excludedDiagnostic.reason: Initial candidate had pending restored-folder thumbnails, so this is not a valid warm-grid control; same startup defect reproduced in accepted release. Kept as diagnostic evidence, not silently discarded.

notes: Potential hangs are Instruments diagnostics, not confirmed dropped/presented frames.

One cached full-order index may remain when the visible subset is filtered; retain measured RSS without a memory reduction or peak bound.
Fresh process recommended per run; temporary SQLite database, unchanged FULL durability, no image/sidecar writes or shared thumbnail disk cache.
All input image bytes hashed before/after outside timing/sampling. OS caches are warmed by hashing; cold means new process/database, not cold physical storage.
IncludesSubfolders identifies combined parent-folder scope; distinct same-named files retain their folder identities. File-count ceiling includes all descendants.
Folder-open repeats inventory after validation/hashing. Timings include actual workspace model and per-photo display records.
First Fit and selected readiness overlap full EXIF/decision indexing; readiness polls at 1ms, not native keyboard-to-display time.
Navigation uses model selection and the Fit pipeline at 2560px, with a 64MiB RAM cache. Forward/reverse/spread do not guarantee cache hits; decode counts are reported.
No SwiftUI rendering, thumbnail-grid loading, 35ms view debounce, presented frames, full RAW detail or bulk save/XMP throughput in this service report.
